verdict.rationale: monday.com documents a public GraphQL API for interacting with and automating workflows, along with SDKs, granular OAuth-style scopes, event webhooks such as create_item and change_column_value, and programmatic control of agents. A documented official MCP server adds an agent-friendly route into the same capabilities. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API, in-depth reference detail beyond landing-page claims, and an AI-oriented docs index (llms.txt returns 404).
